answer: In PoA, EigenTrust-style centrality is propagated through reciprocity-weighted trust links, while reputation decays exponentially with an explicit half-life: without sustained honest service, past contributions steadily lose influence. A fresh identity—whether named violet, crystal, or canyon—has near-zero centrality because it lacks trusted paths and accrued history; creating many such identities does not manufacture trust, so they cannot meet the consensus threshold.
